definitions.explanation: The muscle that forms the wall of the heart and pumps the blood. Mostly heard in the names of heart diseases, above all {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく} (heart attack).

examples.japanese: {心筋|しんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}っている→弱る：02439_yowaru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧、⟦{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}→心筋梗塞：20487_shinkinkousoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My father collapsed with a heart attack last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かなく→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{心筋|しんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短時間|たんじかん}→短時間：18286_tanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死|し}んで→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧しまう。
examples.english: When blood stops reaching it, heart muscle tissue dies within a short time.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}→心筋梗塞：20487_shinkinkousoku⟧: myocardial infarction, heart attack
- {心筋炎|しんきんえん}: myocarditis
- {心筋症|しんきんしょう}: cardiomyopathy

WATCH OUT:
{心筋|しんきん} (heart muscle) and ⟦{真菌|しんきん}→真菌：26316_shinkin⟧ (fungus, as in fungal infections) are homophones; both are medical words, so the compound usually decides which is meant.
